<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0 -->
# T025 — Native EOF integration report

Implemented an explicit versioned advisory path from observed effects and T024 controlled EN/ES input to three unchanged native preparation consumers. Active discovery, policies and execution authorization remain unchanged. No model inference, training, calibration, human acceptance, activation or external spend.

## Obtained integration result

Development: 120/120 correct route attempts; 10 repositories; gate passed: True.
Integration evaluation: 240/240 correct route attempts over 20 reused synthetic repositories, four correlated views and three recipients.
Prepared actions: 168; accepted action errors: 0; correct semantic defers: 72; technical refusals/errors: 0; action coverage: 70.0%.
Eligibility disagreements: 0; native preparations with every step/final tree matching the pinned Git observations: 168; actual stdio preparations: 56.
EN/ES consistency: 120/120 correlated groups; recipient consistency: 80/80 groups.
Rejected forged proposals: 720, including 96 inadmissible-k0 probes; all refused before native proof/consumer calls. Every route trial tests a rehashed invalid option, wrong semantic version and wrong recipient.
Prepared choice counts: {"k0": 144, "k2": 24}.

## Concrete code and scope

The new bridge imports the frozen T024 verifier for both eligibility and predicted tree materialization, binds the semantic version in a new proposal format, then reacquires effects and rechecks the handoff. The single prepare_decision entry point returns answered, semantic-defer or refused with counters, provenance, proposal and native prepared result. Caller-supplied cached native proofs are not accepted.
Recipients are core git_runtime.prepare_run, analysis-only ToolingService prepare, and a real stdio peer calling stock agent_braid.mcp_runtime. Native replay and preparation validate the selected order and expected tree. No default consumer registry, public v1 contract, CLI alias, persistent run, grant store, source promotion, execute or recover call is added by this study. Legacy source files and packets are preserved.
This is a reusable experimental integration seam, not a completed general-purpose System One product. The stock stdio endpoint advertises execution tools, but only initialize, tool discovery and prepare are called. No new Codex/Claude native-host or optional SDK acceptance is claimed. Software runtime tests are separate and may create their own synthetic grants/runs.

## Evidence boundary

The corpus is the already-open T024 population copied byte-for-byte except the repository location in ingress. Labels/direct truth and both Git-dependent reference passes are reused; actual selected native replay/preparation executes again. This adds integration conformance evidence, not a new holdout, independent accuracy observations or a general NLP result. The 240 route attempts represent 80 existing semantic views over 20 repositories and ten related recipes.
The improvement is correct propagation of the EOF semantics through native consumers, without silently returning to T021 at handoff or tree prediction. No improvement is attributed to a learned model. Zero errors and nonzero coverage are descriptive screening results, not a population error bound of 1%, independent validation, real-workload acceptance or Laya parity.

## Latency and resource accounting

| Recipient | All-attempt median ms | Answered median ms | Defer median ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| core-api | 7684.578 | 9030.572 | 1136.146 |
| mcp-service | 14064.255 | 16637.665 | 1243.370 |
| mcp-stdio | 13408.306 | 16537.787 | 1298.800 |

Latency starts at ingress and includes acquisition, extraction, proposal/tree construction, handoff reacquisition, fresh native proof, native preparation and scratch cleanup. Stdio cold startup/discovery/cleanup is included. Refusal probes are excluded from trial latency and charged in total phase cost. Recipient order is fixed and execution serial; the machine is not claimed exclusive. Do not compare these totals with T024 selection-only latency as a speedup.
New experiment wall seconds: 3834.115311042; charged cumulative: 50892.440410723/86400, with prior attempts retained and no clock reset. Sampled peak own worker-group RSS: 52101120 bytes. Limits: <=2h new study, <=16GiB sampled group RSS, <=20GiB outputs; software checks timed separately.
M3 Pro, isolated existing Python, one-thread environment, OS-denied experimental network, no downloads or provider calls; EUR 0. Registered sources: 298. Full raw route results, rejected proposals, transport transcripts, native step manifests, source/fixture archives and receipts are retained.

## Software checks and delivery

Spec Kit preflight passed before edits; six focused positive/negative tests passed.
quick: exit 0; full suite 2190 tests; 3056.191 seconds; source inputs matched at completion: True. Full logs and exact hashes are retained; inspect skips separately.
pr: exit 0; full suite 2190 tests; 3058.847 seconds; source inputs matched at completion: True. Full logs and exact hashes are retained; inspect skips separately.
Final task/report completion and evidence packaging occur after profiles; the registered experimental candidate/data stay byte-identical. Source-equivalent lean local clones share existing isolated dependencies; this is software validation, not independent clean-room reproduction.

## Next implementation handoff

The integration seam now supplies a concrete extraction target for the native delivery program: a separately versioned verified-decision contract, deterministic domain adapter/verifier and native preparation consumer. Preserve the existing synthetic/probabilistic v1 contract; deterministic admissibility must not be encoded as calibrated probability. A separate planning conversation prepares specs, issue drafts, dependency-ordered tasks and agent ownership outside this checkout.
Next coding lot: use those contract/ownership packets to extract reusable package modules with compatibility tests, then extend supported decision families behind explicit domain admission. Avoid repeating wording/model sweeps before a new falsifiable hypothesis or capability gap exists.
Training, new calibration, human review, data admission, representative workflow acceptance, independent validation, activation, publication and Laya parity remain pending.

Reproduction command: `.venv-speckit/bin/python -m research.system_one.eof_consumers.study run --output <new-owned-output>`. Existing output is refused, all attempts remain charged, and failed registered lots are never resumed automatically. Reproduction is separate from this observed integration run.
